name: Cauliflower
storage: Whole head: wrap loosely in a cloth or paper bag in the fridge's vegetable drawer, 4–7 days. Florets: blanch 2 minutes, cool, and freeze up to 6 months (for cooking, e.g. in bhaji). Soak florets in warm salted water for 10 minutes before cooking to drive out insects.
looksLike: A tight, creamy-white head of florets (the "curd") wrapped in thick green leaves. A medium head weighs about 400–600 g.
howToPick: Heavy for its size, with a tight, compact, creamy-white head and fresh, crisp green leaves. Avoid brown or black spots, loose or spreading florets, a yellowish tint, or a strong sulphur smell. Check between florets for small green caterpillars.

usedIn.raw: 30 g (3–4 small florets, about ¼ cup chopped)
